scientific_boundary.historically_frozen_definition_rule: Only a mapping present in an independently recoverable pre-search source may be called historically frozen.

infer definitions from support values or prevalence

result indices only; no source, mapping, or freeze metadata

limitations: The labels do not define behavioral observations or complete selectors.
No unlisted ID may be labeled discovery by inference.

readme.claim_boundary: calibration/self-discrimination; HD component explicitly calibrated to behavioral features already associated with the case

why_not_model_b_v2: The engine does not use D1-D10 or the requested HD A1-A6 identifiers.
It does not define behavioral observations or questionnaire responses for the channel weights.
It has no per-path directness, role, dependency, contradiction, or conditional-prevalence assignments.
Its A1-A10 functions are Western-astrology modules and must not be conflated with the legacy HD A1-A6 identifiers.
Transferring D labels from the later result would be outcome-based reconstruction.
